mechanism: NSAIDs may increase mefloquine levels by reducing renal clearance and competing for protein binding, while mefloquine can increase NSAID GI toxicity risk; both drugs have CNS effects that may be additive.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for mefloquine toxicity (neuropsychiatric effects, dizziness) and GI complications, consider alternative analgesics or prophylactic GI protection.
